items.title: refactor(gateway): move startup database work off the main thread (#1…
items.summary: refactor(gateway): move startup database work off the main thread (#169880) Move approval recovery, config revision-key creation, config preparation, hook selection, cron partition selection, and Claw provenance preparation through their existing database workers. Await required preparation before Gateway readiness and remove the superseded synchronous startup paths. Keep approval and consent authority with their existing owners. Batch approval recovery in one transaction, retain the durable revision key with an atomic upsert, and reuse committed facts and captured startup selections. No schema, stored-format, retention, or update behavior changes.

items.title: perf(state): reduce repeated schema checks on Gateway restart (#170017)
items.summary: perf(state): reduce repeated schema checks on Gateway restart (#170017) Reuse admitted physical schema facts before shared-state restart checks and skip historical discovery for current content. Keep canonical indexes, newer-version refusal, integrity checks, owned-DDL invalidation, and existing update/Doctor behavior. Two isolated baseline/candidate pairs reduce complete restart main-thread statements from 769 to 725. Warmed MAIN remains zero; the confirmation shared read families are unchanged. The 40% target was not reached, and loaded-host latency remains inconclusive. Static gates, two Codex reviews, and published 2026.10.2 updater-to-candidate acceptance passed. Land under the authorized relaxed policy with CI failure attribution and unresolved follow-ups recorded in the PR.

items.title: fix(cli): reject invalid cron expressions at the CLI and fix the misl…
items.summary: fix(cli): reject invalid cron expressions at the CLI and fix the misleading "choose exactly one schedule" error (#168163) A single positional 'every ...' schedule for openclaw cron add/edit filled both the every and cron slots, producing a false 'Choose exactly one schedule' error, and malformed cron expressions surfaced as opaque Gateway CronPattern errors. An every-prefixed positional now fills only the every slot, and the CLI validates cron expressions with the same croner rules the scheduler uses, reporting a clear error with 5- and 6-field examples. Proof: built main and the PR in Docker and ran pnpm openclaw cron add/edit against isolated Gateways. Main showed the false conflict and the opaque parser error; the PR gave the corrected results. Nine valid create/edit controls (every, 5- and 6-field cron, timestamps, timezones, macros, named fields, last-day syntax) produced matching stored schedules on both, and invalid-timezone error precedence is unchanged. Thanks @xialonglee. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: 特斯拉在歐洲將FSD改名為Tesla Assisted Driving，以推動歐盟核准
items.summary: 電動車大廠特斯拉（Tesla）近日將歐洲市場的Full Self-Driving（FSD，完全自動駕駛）駕駛輔助系統更名為Tesla Assisted Driving（特斯拉輔助駕駛），目前其德國官網已採用新名稱。

items.title: Citrix修補NetScaler重大等級的SAML漏洞
items.summary: 從9月底至10月上旬，Citrix為NetScaler修補一系列資安漏洞，其中重大等級的CVE-2026-88771、CVE-2026-88772，以及CVE-2026-88779已遭到利用。如今該公司再度發布緊急更新，受到外界高度關注。

items.title: 攻擊者利用WordPress兩款外掛XSS漏洞入侵網站，植入後門並建立隱藏的管理帳號，威脅逾50萬網站
items.summary: 攻擊者正利用兩款WordPress外掛程式的跨網站指令碼（XSS）漏洞，試圖入侵網站並建立隱藏管理員帳號。資安業者Patchstack於10月6日指出，研究人員於10月4日觀察到針對WordPress外掛WPC Product Bundles for WooCommerce的攻擊，隔日又發現相同攻擊程式利用另一外掛Ninja Forms的漏洞。

items.title: DNS根區域時隔8年更換簽章金鑰，未更新信任錨恐使網站無法連線
items.summary: 網際網路號碼分配局（IANA）宣布，DNS根區域（Root Zone）自10月11日起改由新金鑰KSK-2024負責簽署，取代原本的KSK-2017，這是繼2018年首次輪替後，時隔8年再次更換根區域金鑰。IANA提醒，啟用DNSSEC驗證卻未更新信任錨（Trust Anchor）的DNS解析器，可能無法驗證根區域資料，導致網域名稱解析失敗，但預期多數使用者不會受到影響。
